description: This file appears to be a shell script used for testing Git's 'intent to add' functionality, containing various test cases that check Git commands and behaviors related to adding files, status, renames, and diffs.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a successful test case with a given description and commands.

methods.name: test_commit
methods.description: Creates a commit with a specified message.

methods.name: test_must_fail
methods.description: Ensures the last command fails as expected.

methods.name: test_must_be_empty
methods.description: Checks that the output of a command is empty.

methods.name: test_tick
methods.description: Advances the test’s timestamp or state.

methods.name: test_grep
methods.description: Searches for a pattern in command output.

methods.name: test_cmp
methods.description: Compares expected and actual output files.

methods.name: test_done
methods.description: Marks the end of all test cases.

methods.name: git hash-object
methods.description: Creates an object with a hash based on file content.

methods.name: git ls-files
methods.description: Lists files in the index and working tree.

methods.name: git status
methods.description: Shows the status of the working directory and index.

methods.name: git write-tree
methods.description: Creates a tree object from the index.

methods.name: git diff
methods.description: Shows differences between various states of the working tree and index.

methods.name: git diff-files
methods.description: Shows changes between the working directory and index.
